operative_clauses.judgment_reason: Terminated on 1982-08-17 by EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, 47 FR 36099), whose section 20 revokes Executive Order No. 12083, as amended, establishing the Energy Coordinating Committee. Actor: the President, by EO 12379. EO 12121 only adds items (x) and (y) to section 1-102 of EO 12083; EO 12083 has no sunset, so the amended list operated until EO 12379 revoked EO 12083 'as amended', which carries EO 12121's additions with it. EO 12379 states no effective date, so the revocation is read as effective on signing; it does not name EO 12121 by number, and the reading that the amendment survives the revocation of the order it amends is rejected because the amendment has nothing to operate on once the order is revoked. EO 12379's recital that it ends committees that are 'inactive or no longer necessary' is not treated as an earlier end. The later amendments of EO 12148 and EO 12156 add a different member and are events, not ends.

research_rationale:
EO 12121 (signed 1979-02-26; 44 FR 11195, Federal Register of February 28, 1979) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12121.txt (PDF page 19; heading Executive Order 12121 of February 26, 1979, subject Energy Coordinating Committee; number, date and subject agree with the census register row). It is one amendment: Section 1-102 of Executive Order No. 12083 of September 27, 1978 is amended by adding in alphabetical order item (x), the Director of the Community Services Administration, and item (y), the Chairman of the Council on Wage and Price Stability, to the membership of the Energy Coordinating Committee. It has no own-terms end, condition, report clause or sunset. The parent order EO 12083 (held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12083.txt, 43 FR 44813, Federal Register of September 29, 1978) was read in full: it establishes the Committee to coordinate Federal energy policy, lists its members in section 1-102, creates an Executive Council, revokes EO 11814, and contains no sunset, termination or report clause. First end: EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17; 47 FR 36099, Federal Register of August 19, 1982; held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12379.txt, PDF pages 9-10), section 20, revokes Executive Order No. 12083 'as amended', establishing the Energy Coordinating Committee. EO 12379 has no effective-date wording, so the revocation is read as effective on signing. The reason this revocation ends the command of EO 12121 (and is not merely a later formal disposition): EO 12121 acts only by amending a list inside EO 12083, EO 12083 has no sunset and so stayed in force, with its list as amended, until revoked, and section 20 revokes EO 12083 'as amended', which is EO 12083 including the additions made by EO 12121. EO 12379 names EO 12083 and not EO 12121 by number; the alternative reading, that an amendment not named by number survives the revocation of the order it amends, leaves a list inside a revoked order with nothing to operate on. Earlier ends tested and not found: EO 12379 recites that it terminates the establishing authorities of committees that are 'inactive or no longer necessary', but inactivity is not a legal end of EO 12083, which commands no performance by a date; no held instrument revokes, supersedes or amends EO 12083 or EO 12121 before 1982-08-17 other than the two amendments below; no held source dates any abolition of the Committee or of the Council on Wage and Price Stability, and the claim does not rely on one. Later events recorded, none an end: EO 12148 section 5-211 (signed 1979-07-20) adds item (x), the Director of the Federal Emergency Management Agency, to section 1-102 of EO 12083 without mentioning EO 12121, and EO 12156 section 1-101 (signed 1979-09-10; 44 FR 53073) corrects that item to read as a further amendment of EO 12083, as amended by EO 12121, adding item (z). EO 12288 (1981-01-29) revokes EO 12092 and does not mention EO 12083 or EO 12121. The U.S. Code, eCFR and OFR catalog machine searches were read for coverage; they record no other instrument affecting this order.

Nothing revokes, supersedes or terminates EO 12083 or the Committee before EO 12379 section 20 (1982-08-17). savings_residuals.reason: Read EO 12121 and EO 12379 for savings or continuing effects: EO 12121 states none, and EO 12379 section 20 revokes EO 12083 as amended with no savings or transfer wording. The amendment only enlarged a committee's membership and created no right, fund, property or appointment that outlasts the Committee, so nothing keeps the order operative after 1982-08-17.
